course.title: Biological Sciences BSc | University of Warwick
quotes: Qualification Bachelor of Science (BSc) Department School of Life Sciences Duration 3 years full-time

A level typical offer AAB including Biology and a second Science (e.g., Chemistry, Physics, Maths, Applied Science, Environmental Science, Statistics, Geology, Geography, or Psychology) or AAA including Biology.
